query:
WITH april_entries AS (
  SELECT 
    TRIM(nationality) AS nationality,
    TRIM(entry_location_name) AS entry_port,
    COUNT(*) AS entry_count
  FROM estishraf_llm_border_crossings_impala
  WHERE person_type = 'resident'
    AND entry_timestamp >= '2025-04-01'
    AND entry_timestamp < '2025-05-01'
    AND entry_location_name IS NOT NULL
    AND nationality IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY TRIM(nationality), TRIM(entry_location_name)
),
nationality_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    nationality,
    SUM(entry_count) AS total_entries
  FROM april_entries
  GROUP BY nationality
),
top_10_nationalities AS (
  SELECT nationality
  FROM nationality_totals
  ORDER BY total_entries DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
port_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ae.nationality,
    ae.entry_port,
    ae.entry_count,
    nt.total_entries,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ae.nationality ORDER BY ae.entry_count DESC) AS rn,
    ROUND(ae.entry_count * 100.0 / nt.total_entries, 2) AS percentage
  FROM april_entries ae
  JOIN nationality_totals nt ON ae.nationality = nt.nationality
  JOIN top_10_nationalities t10 ON ae.nationality = t10.nationality
)
SELECT 
  nationality,
  entry_port,
  entry_count,
  total_entries,
  percentage
FROM port_stats
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_entries DESC
LIMIT 10
